== Biography ==
Agnes was born in 1770. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-3314|John Glasgow]] and [[Mill-757|Margaret Mill]].
== Research Notes ==
=== West Calder baptism: conflicting name fields ===

The two previously inspected derivatives name Agnes Glasgow as the child baptised on 15 July 1770 at West Calder, with parents John Glasgow and Margaret Mill.<ref name="WestCalderPrior">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births &amp; Baptisms 1564–1929'', [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_687777145&tab=this R_687777145] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_686351037&tab=this R_686351037], Agnes Glasgow, baptism 15 July 1770, West Calder; father John Glasgow, mother Margaret Mill. Held derivative fields reviewed; original register uninspected.</ref>

A newly inspected OPR derivative for the same parish and baptism day gives the child's first name as a dash, father John Glasgow, and '''Agnes in the mother's given-name field''', without a maternal surname. Its reference is OPR 701/1, item 5.<ref name="WestCalder1770Conflict">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births &amp; Baptisms 1564–1929'', [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4628212 SCOT/OPR/BAP/4628212], West Calder, baptism 15 July 1770, OPR 701/1, item 5, register range 1645–1819; child's first name “-”, father John Glasgow, mother's first name Agnes. Derivative inspected 4 November 2026; original register uninspected.</ref>

The matching baptism day, parish and father support comparison with this Agnes, but the missing child name and different maternal field prevent an unqualified identification. A field-role or indexing discrepancy is possible; a distinct entry is also possible. The original register is needed to read the child and mother in their actual positions. The new derivative is not silently rewritten to name child Agnes or mother Margaret, and the older Margaret Mill readings are not discarded.

The existing [[Glasgow-3314|John Glasgow]] and [[Mill-757|Margaret Mill]] parentage and the recorded 81% paternal assessment remain unchanged. The new transcript does not identify its mother Agnes with this child or establish another mother or child. All three sources give baptism, not an independently explicit birthday; the existing exact birth field is not changed. No new adult identity for John or extra confidence follows from these related derivative readings.

=== Current research ===

One West Calder baptism on 15 July 1770 names John Glasgow and Margaret Mill, matching the existing child. These transcripts give 15 July as baptism, not an explicit birth date. The catalogue currently displays an exact 15 July birthday; its independent birth-date basis still needs checking before that precision is retained or corrected. The 1810 Edinburgh burial is only a weaker comparison: this child would be 40 against the recorded 32. No death or Geo Smart marriage is assigned.
